title: Make container statistics scoped bounded loading-list evidence
description: Users opening the existing container statistics report see only authorized approved loading-list headers with truthful grouping and measures. Require non-null SalespersonDataScope service argument; existing ReportController endpoint resolves identity/container-stats menu/fresh scope before service. Validate start/end before reads, then apply approved/nondeleted/date/customer-scope predicates before the stable 501-header probe; no unbounded reads, no detail/current-product/booking lookup or per-row queries. Replace global raw ContainerNo grouping with explicit evidence buckets by loading calendar date and exact persisted raw nonblank ContainerNo; blank/whitespace numbers stay separate per loading-list ID, never merged into a fake shared container. Stable bucket key/order, loading-list count, distinct positive customer ID count explicitly labelled authorized-scope count, and invalid/missing customer identity count/reason. Sum signed persisted TotalCartons/TotalWeight/TotalVolume as separate recorded header measures in cartons/kg/m3, distinguish zero from missing identity, never claim actual shipment or physical-container quantity. Existing 68m3/40HQ assumption lacks authoritative capacity/complete-container evidence: Utilization becomes nullable unknown with reason and TypeText no longer infers full-container/pooling type from scoped customer counts. Add mandatory source/coverage/grouping/capacity/type/quantity basis labels. Page table/KPI separate list/bucket counts and each unit, no money formatting/unit, summing unlike measures or claiming physical containers. Modify only container statistics behavior in shared ReportService.Extra.cs and reports.js, preserving purchase-cost and unrelated reports. Development only. Reuse existing container-stats menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope, approved nondeleted ContainerLoadingLists and OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Each endpoint revalidates current input and rechecks identity/menu/fresh scope; revoked permission, invalid input and source overflow return no data/file. Date span <=366 inclusive days, whole end day via next-day exclusive boundary with overflow rejection, stable source probe Take(501) and fail closed above 500 authorized matching list headers. Recorded cartons/kg/m3 are scoped list-header evidence, not verified stock-out, actual shipping, revenue or physical container totals. Partial customer scope must never reveal excluded customers/records or infer whole-container utilization, type, capacity or shipping state. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance is environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Existing API/service require fresh identity/menu/customer scope, approved-only validated dates and fail-closed 500-list cap before source materialization.
Date/raw-number evidence buckets keep blank IDs separate, explicit scoped list/customer counts and signed unit measures, with unknown utilization/type instead of unsupported 68m3 assumptions.

Existing table/KPI shows truthful units and mandatory scope/grouping/capacity context; scope/bounds/grouping/UI tests cover excluded/draft/deleted records, end-day timestamps, overflow and missing identities, and safe build/test passes.
